m.max_dur, is_skewed = (CASE WHEN m.max_dur > m.p50 * 2 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END), locality_summary = m_loc.loc_summary, performance_score = (100.0 - (COALESCE((m.total_gc * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0) * 0.15 + CASE WHEN m.p50 > 0 THEN LEAST(100, (m.max_dur * 1.0 / m.p50 - 1) * 50) ELSE 0 END * 0.15 + CASE WHEN m.total_disk_spill > 0 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END * 0.15 + (100.0 - LEAST(100, COALESCE((m.total_cpu_time / 1000000.0 * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_run_time, 0)), 100))) * 0.10 + COALESCE((m.total_delay * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0) * 0.05 + COALESCE(((m.total_ser + m.total_deser) * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0) * 0.05 + COALESCE((m.total_get_res * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0) * 0.05)), diagnosis_info = json_array(json_object('dimension', 'GC Impact', 'score', CAST(greatest(0, 100 - COALESCE((m.total_gc * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0)) AS INTEGER)), json_object('dimension', 'Shuffle Write Impact', 'score', CAST(greatest(0, 100 - COALESCE((m.total_sw_time / 1000000.0 * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0)) AS INTEGER)), json_object('dimension', 'Shuffle Read Blocked', 'score', CAST(greatest(0, 100 - COALESCE((m.total_fetch_wait / 1000000.0 * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0)) AS INTEGER)), json_object('dimension', 'I/O Wait', 'score', CAST(LEAST(100, COALESCE((m.total_cpu_time / 1000000.0 * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_run_time, 0)), 100)) AS INTEGER)), json_object('dimension', 'Serialization Impact', 'score', CAST(greatest(0, 100 - COALESCE(((m.total_ser + m.total_deser) * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0)) AS INTEGER)), json_object('dimension', 'Result Fetching', 'score', CAST(greatest(0, 100 - COALESCE((m.total_get_res * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, 0)), 0)) AS INTEGER)), json_object('dimension', 'Scheduler Delay Impact', 'score', CAST(greatest(0, 100 - COALESCE((m.total_delay * 100.0 / NULLIF(m.total_duration, COALESCE(sum(scheduler_delay), 0) as total_delay, COALESCE(max(peak_execution_memory), 0) as max_peak_mem, COALESCE(sum(peak_execution_memory), 0) as total_peak_mem, COALESCE(sum(memory_bytes_spilled), 0) as total_mem_spill, COALESCE(sum(disk_bytes_spilled), 0) as total_disk_spill, COALESCE(sum(shuffle_write_time), 0) as total_sw_time, COALESCE(sum(shuffle_fetch_wait_time), 0) as total_fetch_wait, COALESCE(sum(executor_cpu_time), 0) as total_cpu_time, COALESCE(sum(executor_run_time), 0) as total_run_time, COALESCE(sum(input_bytes), 0) as total_input, COALESCE(sum(input_records), 0) as total_input_records, COALESCE(sum(output_bytes), 0) as total_output, COALESCE(sum(output_records), 0) as total_output_records, COALESCE(sum(shuffle_read_bytes), 0) as total_shuffle_read, COALESCE(sum(shuffle_read_records), 0) as total_shuffle_read_records, COALESCE(sum(shuffle_write_bytes), 0) as total_shuffle_write, COALESCE(sum(shuffle_write_records), 0) as total_shuffle_write_records, COALESCE(approx_quantile(duration, 0.5), 0) as p50, COALESCE(approx_quantile(duration, 0.95), 0) as p95, COALESCE(approx_quantile(duration, 0.99), 0) as p99, COALESCE(max(duration), 0) as max_dur FROM gold_tasks WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND stage_id IN #{id} GROUP BY app_id, stage_id, attempt_id ) m, ( SELECT base.app_id, base.stage_id, base.attempt_id, string_agg(k || ': ' || v, ', ') as loc_summary FROM ( SELECT app_id, stage_id, attempt_id, locality as k, count(*) as v FROM gold_tasks WHERE base.attempt_id ) m_loc WHERE gold_stages.app_id = m.app_id AND gold_stages.stage_id = m.stage_id AND gold_stages.attempt_id = m.attempt_id AND m.app_id = m_loc.app_id AND m.stage_id = m_loc.stage_id
